sources.entry: Sidebar - The modern Dock replacement for your Mac.

summary.name: Sidebar
summary.one_liner: Sidebar is a customizable Dock replacement for macOS that adds a configurable sidebar with app launching, window previews, window switching, and window snapping.
use_cases: organize apps and folders in a sidebar
hide all windows to reach the desktop
control media playback from the sidebar
summary.what_it_does: Sidebar places a customizable bar on one, some, or all screens, with per-screen settings and an option to reserve screen space so windows do not overlap it. It shows window previews on hover and a display style that can show icons or individual windows with titles. It includes a start menu style app launcher, a window switcher with filters and search, and window snapping by dragging windows to screen edges. Additional built-in items include stacks, sound volume and mute, a calendar, trash access, and a Clear View mode that hides all apps at once.
notable: One-time app with all updates included, with no paid version upgrades (2, 3, ...)
Window snapping and window save/restore designed to work with Sidebar
Privacy claim: no usage data collected or shared; only license data transferred on purchase
caveats: Free 7-day trial; continued use requires purchase (page implies paid license)
